Mar Vista Investment Partners Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 0.58% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mar Vista Investment Partners Llc bought 2,071 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 356,326 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $60.30 million, up from 354,255 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mar Vista Investment Partners Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $924.93B market cap company. The stock increased 0.93% or $1.74 during the last trading session, reaching $188.18. About 17.26M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Cooper Creek Partners Management Llc increased its stake in Fusion Telecom (FSNN) by 28.77% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund held 1.16 million shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.34 million, up from 898,706 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cooper Creek Partners Management Llc who had been investing in Fusion Telecom for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $185.73 million market cap company.
